about: The merch design sprint of Monday 2 November 2026: the concepts for the T-shirts, hoodies and cards, a colour for each of the seven, and the options the team votes on (people/<id>/feedback/design.json). Mock-ups are made from this file by team/designer/mockups/make-mockups.py. Every QR goes to the person's /meet/<id>/ page, so the printed code never has to change.

tees.name: Do you know what your agents are doing?
tees.why: A question nobody can answer with a yes; the back says the wearer can.

tees.why: Says what RiskMandate is in five words and asks the question.

tees.why: For buyers of agents: the risk they haven't thought about.

tees.name: Ask me how I control my agents
tees.why: An open invitation; works for anyone on the team, technical or not.

tees.name: RISK MANDATE: agents with a mandate
tees.why: The brand, big: for when we want the name remembered more than a question.

tees.name: I brought 6 agents to Web Summit
tees.why: True, playful, and a demo in itself: each of us runs an agentic team.

tees.name: The plain backup
tees.why: If the venue pushes back on messages: the name on the chest, the QR on the back.

tees.name: Know their reach. Define their mandate. Control the gap.
tees.why: RiskMandate's own line, from Silvio's video: the product in three short sentences.
